description: A dropdown select component built on Radix UI Select. Provides full keyboard navigation, ARIA listbox semantics, and focus management.

keyboard.action: Opens the select dropdown or selects the focused option
Closes the dropdown and returns focus to the trigger
Focuses the first option matching the typed characters

focus.notes: Focus moves to the selected item (or first item) when the dropdown opens. On close, focus returns to the trigger button. The trigger shows a focus-visible ring.

announcements: Trigger announces current value and "combobox" role
Options announce their label and selected state
Group labels are announced as group headings
The selected value is announced when changed
screenReader.notes: Radix handles all ARIA attributes automatically including aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, and aria-selected.

contrast.text: Trigger and option text meet WCAG AA
contrast.ui: Focus and selected states use accent colors meeting 3:1

consumerResponsibilities: Always include SelectValue with a placeholder for empty state
Use SelectGroup and SelectLabel to organize related options
Disabled items should have clear visual indication
